clusters.headline: New Delhi Air Quality Deteriorates Following Deepavali Celebrations
aiSummaryBullets: New Delhi's air quality index reached 303 as seasonal smog combined with the impact of firecracker displays during Deepavali.
The Central Pollution Control Board addressed discrepancies in reporting, while the Supreme Court highlighted vehicular emissions as a factor.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Belonging Sparks Political And Personal Debate
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi's newly released memoir, Belonging, addresses personal tragedies, including the loss of a child and political reflections.
The book has triggered political controversy, with the BJP disputing the author's account of the 1984 anti-Sikh massacre.

clusters.headline: Hardik Pandya Moves To Punjab Kings In Trade With Mumbai Indians
aiSummaryBullets: Hardik Pandya has concluded his second tenure with the Mumbai Indians after three seasons.
The Punjab Kings acquired Pandya in a trade deal with the Mumbai franchise.

clusters.headline: Recent Developments Across Tamil Nadu Span Policy And Public Safety
aiSummaryBullets: Justice M.V. Muralidharan has been named the new chairperson of the Tamil Nadu State Commission for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
Three workers have died following an incident at a facility producing iPhone components owned by Tata.

clusters.headline: Kolkata-Sairang Express Derails Near Digaru Railway Station Assam
aiSummaryBullets: Several coaches and the engine of the Kolkata-Sairang Express derailed at Digaru station in Assam.
Conflicting reports exist regarding casualties, with some sources citing no injuries and others noting multiple injured passengers.

clusters.headline: CISCE Releases 2027 Examination Timetables For Class 10 And 12
aiSummaryBullets: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) released official timetables for the 2027 board sessions.
ISC Class 12 examinations are scheduled to take place between February 9 and April 8, 2027.

clusters.headline: Indian Political Parties Exchange Accusations Over Religious Sites
aiSummaryBullets: The Congress party has demanded an expanded investigation into the theft of donations at the Ram temple.
Congress representatives have called for a Supreme Court-monitored probe involving the BJP and RSS regarding temple funds.

clusters.headline: Security Procedures Triggered Following Note On Air India Flight
aiSummaryBullets: A note threatening a hijacking was found in the washroom of an Air India aircraft before its scheduled departure.
The flight, which was preparing to travel from Kolkata to Mumbai, was moved to an isolation bay for safety.

clusters.headline: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Comments On Deepavali Air Pollution
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath addressed concerns regarding post-Deepavali pollution levels.
The Chief Minister stated that the increase in air pollution following the festival is temporary and will dissipate.

clusters.headline: Mother Dairy Implements Milk Price Increase Across Delhi-NCR Region
aiSummaryBullets: Mother Dairy is increasing milk prices by two to four rupees per litre.
The new pricing structure for the supplier becomes effective on November 12.
